name: Beepixl Product Enquiry for WooCommerce
author: beepixl

sections.description:
Beepixl Product Enquiry for WooCommerce adds enquiry buttons to WooCommerce products so customers can quickly contact you for questions or quote requests.

Features

  • Show enquiry buttons on shop/category and single product pages.
  • Enable WhatsApp and Facebook enquiry channels.
  • Customize button text and colors.
  • Enable optional floating enquiry buttons.
  • Choose left or right floating position.

WhatsApp Settings

  • Add WhatsApp number with country code.
  • Configure icon and text colors.
  • Display WhatsApp on single products and shop archives.
  • Set a default enquiry message.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to wp-admin and open Enquiry settings.
  4. Save your channel configuration and button options.
